subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Protecting it required more than adding sand.”?
options: Respecting rules in shared spaces is a way of letting strangers rest.
Respecting digital work means respecting the person who made it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Respecting rules in shared spaces is a way of letting strangers rest.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Protecting it required more than adding sand. It required respecting movement.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「They should protect human movement.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Respecting digital work means respecting the person who made it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Protecting it required more than adding sand. It required respecting movement.」，答案為「It required respecting movement.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It required respecting movement.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
